title: Which tools do Claude, Codex and Cursor choose? We measured 17k runs to find out
summary: An empirical study analyzing which tools AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, Cursor) choose to install, based on 17,000 experimental runs to understand their tool selection patterns and decision-making behaviors.
problem_solved: Understanding how different AI coding agents make tool installation and selection decisions in real-world coding tasks.
why_valuable: Provides quantitative data and insights into AI agent behavior, helping developers understand and predict how different coding assistants approach tool usage in development workflows.
